name: Rezonant
description:
Rezonant is where product teams shape what they're building — defining specs and PRDs, pulling in context, aligning the team, and spinning up tasks for coding agents. This connector closes the gap between that upstream work and the code.

Once connected, your agent can pull the projects, specs, PRDs, tasks, and product context from your Rezonant workspace whenever you ask — so decisions made upstream carry into the build without you re-explaining them. It can also create, update, and delete Rezonant artefacts (projects, documents, tasks) and start coding-agent jobs, right from your editor.

Common uses:
- Implement a feature exactly as it was scoped and agreed in Rezonant
- Pick up a spec you didn't write, with full context in your coding environment
- Review the reasoning behind a feature before you build it
- Manage tasks and documents without leaving your agent

Access is secured with OAuth and scoped to the workspace and teams you authorize. Works with the free tier.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Rezonant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Rezonant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.rezonant.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Rezonant MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rezonant lists 26 MCP tools, including create_coding_job, create_document, create_project, create_task, delete_document, delete_project, delete_task, get_alter, get_coding_job_progress, get_document, get_project, and get_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Rezonant?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Rezonant in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Rezonant requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Rezonant is developed by Rezonant. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
